title: STL - std::array
description:
C++'s `array` header contains the `std::array` class. It's almost the exact same as the code you just wrote! All methods you wrote on your `FSizeArr` class, and has around 4 more important methods. Those are:
- `at(int index)`: The same as `operator[]`, but errors instead of segfaults on out-of-bounds access
- `begin()`: Returns pointer to begin of array (For iterators such as `std::sort` and `std::copy`)
- `end()`: Begin but for the end of the array.
- `empty()`: Returns true if the array is empty.
